summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: @kibt/www-nuxt-i18n@99.0.1 ships a stub `index.js` that exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for every property access, with description 'Compatibility shim.' and an inflated version (99.0.1) consistent with a scoped dependency-confusion / namesquat targeting an internal package. On `npm install` (via the postinstall lifecycle script) and again on `require('@kibt/www-nuxt-i18n')`, `beacon.cjs` POSTs the installer's `os.hostname()`, install path (`__dirname`), current working directory (`process.cwd()`), and Node.js version to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The package has no legitimate functionality; its only effect on install is to confirm reachability of a target environment and report host identifiers to an attacker-controlled host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
